summary: Replicated groups reach your managed tenants again, and PIM Manager is easier to navigate.

new.title: Every menu item opens its own page
new.text: Manager access & roles, Emergency access (Break-glass) and Mail templates are now separate pages. Review standing access is renamed Review current delegations.

new.title: See what a template adds
new.text: Each permission template card has a Show button listing every new permission with a tick box. Import stages only the ticked ones.

new.title: Activation policy in Start here
new.text: The Delegate a permission - Start here wizard now asks which activation policy the delegation uses.

new.title: v1 imports are checked first
new.text: Importing v1 files is validated before anything is written, and the import never deletes and refuses conflicting rows unless you choose otherwise.

fixes.title: Replicated groups reach managed tenants
fixes.text: Groups set to Replicate to managed tenants could reach no tenant. They now reach every tenant their ring and tags allow.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Replication options and rings use plain words, menu badges count only work that needs you, and role-assignable is set correctly for Entra role groups.
